name: Expand and elaborate on provided text segments
description: Users asked to expand, elaborate, or supplement provided text segments to increase their length, detail, or word count while preserving or enhancing the original meaning. The requests varied in scope, ranging from adding specific sentences or emojis to significantly lengthening academic papers, essays, technical documentation, and creative narratives, often with specific word count targets or structural constraints.
